summary: Galiano Gold Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer listed on the NYSE American, furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, together with CEO and CFO certifications and a November 5, 2026 news release. No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed. The filing is a routine quarterly reporting package incorporated by reference into the company's Form F-10 shelf registration; no special-situation event or deal terms are presented.
